title: Thank you Willows Medical!
content: I was at an urgent care clinic in Moorfields and they urgently needed to see some test results that the Willows practice had organised. I had to call to get them emailed to me.  I was a bit reticent as in the past, the phone system wasn't great.  But they now have a new phone system and it worked!  The receptionist immediately dealt with my first request for recent test results and I received the email within minutes.  My second call for more tests results which were done a few years back was also dealt with very speedily and this really helped the doctor at Moorfields. I was really impressed and very grateful.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
